name: Alice
source:
She's the most curious, innocent, and emotionally driven one of the girls. She can be a bit selfish and quite capricious, but she is kind and lachrymose when receiving affection. She's trying to act like a "full-fledged lady," but she is simply too immature to define what it means to be a lady.

Her ignorance, innocence, and naïve sensibilities result in elusive dialogues that are frustrating at turns, yet can also sometimes strike at one's very core.

[translated from [url=https://www.liar.co.jp/fairy/index.html]official website[/url]]
